name: UAV123
description: A drone object tracking benchmark comprising 123 videos. Includes the NFS (Need for Speed) high-frame-rate subset inline. This metadata record does not vendor or distribute dataset data.
citation: Mueller, M., Smith, N., & Ghanem, B. (2016). A Benchmark and Simulator for UAV Tracking. European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2016). The UAV123 benchmark.
